verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing surfaces ML-generated risk scores (fraud, dispute, card-testing) on every authorization, which is a form of AI-generated insight embedded in the product, but this is narrowly scoped to authorization risk rather than broader AI-generated suggestions/insights across spending, budgets, or usage patterns. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-driven analytics/recommendations beyond risk scoring, no dashboard-level 'insights' feature, no independent corroboration of this capability in practice.
